generation.scope: The entire attraction fiber over every closed smooth-quadric window is finite on geometric orbits. Four explicit linear tensor planes yield exactly five classes generally (three of period one and two of period two), and three period-one classes at m squared equal to minus one. The support poset decides every within-fiber degeneration. All special parameters are verified by unit Laurent minors.
